svg.title: How Homa moves a request
svg.desc: The sender transmits an initial portion without waiting for a grant. A request that fits can complete immediately. For a longer request, the receiver grants more bytes and assigns priority; the sender continues as grants allow. Once the full request arrives, the server processes it and sends a response using the same message transfer rules with roles reversed.
svg.text: One request, from sender to receiver
Receivers use priorities to favor short messages.
